semantic_boundaries: Existing headings, paragraph lines and table rows; oversized paragraphs split at sentence endings, emergency cuts explicitly recorded. Heuristic structure, not perfect semantic parsing.
table_boundary_fix: Captions, TABLE marker, column headers and merged sample-description rows stay with data; first up to six literal lines are repeated for long-table parts, capped at512 tokens.
system: Extract all geological study sample, grain, spot or analysis identifiers explicitly written in the input. Copy the original spelling exactly, deduplicate by first entity occurrence, and return only {"entity_ids": [...]}. Do not infer parent names, join prefixes or complete missing sequences. Exclude database record indices, references, figure/table numbers, ages, isotope ratios, coordinates, instruments and reference materials. Do not classify sample versus spot. 仅识别文中实际出现的样品、颗粒、测点或分析编号，原样复制并去重；不分类、不拼接、不续号。仅输出entity_ids字段的JSON对象。
